segments.text: Um, so, can I talk to somebody who's been holding on by a thread this week?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You smiled at work, you posted the picture, you said you were fine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: But on the inside, behind the door nobody sees, you were quietly breaking.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Here's what nobody tells you about the storm: the storm is not your enemy.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The storm is the very thing God is using to wake something up on the inside of you.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Because a faith that has never been tested is a faith that cannot be trusted.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And some of you are about to find out exactly what you are made of.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Turn with me to Mark chapter 4, verse 38, and watch the scene very closely.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Jesus is asleep in the back of the boat while the disciples are panicking for their lives.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And they ask him the question every one of us has asked God at midnight.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Do you not care, Lord, do you not care that we are perishing out here?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: But watch this, watch this: the peace was already in the boat the whole time.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They were screaming for a rescue while their rescue was sleeping right beside them.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Sometimes you are crying out for a peace that is already sleeping on the inside of you.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: When Jesus finally stood up and said peace, be still, the wind did not argue with him.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The wind that was bullying the disciples heard one word and immediately sat down.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That same voice, that same authority, that same power is living down on the inside of you.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You have been talking about the storm, but God says it is time to talk to the storm.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Hallelujah, somebody in this room ought to give God a real praise right about now.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Because the breakthrough you have been begging for is the breakthrough you already carry.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Grace did not bring you this far just to abandon you at the edge of your miracle.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So here is your assignment, church, before you leave this place today.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Stop negotiating with the storm, and stop rehearsing the fear over and over again.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Open your mouth and speak to it the way Jesus did, with the authority you've been given.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Say to that situation, peace, be still, and then watch how fast heaven backs you up.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And listen, if this word found you in the right place today, do not keep it to yourself.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Somebody you love is in a storm right now and they are waiting on your invitation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Bring them with you next Sunday, and let's grow together as a family in this faith.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
